defects: Scene 1 (The explanation fits too well), sentence 2, all themes: a solid causal arrow App choice -> Video watching appears; it asserts the very link the film says is unproven, and the plan cue's 'marked as a question' is not shown. The sentence introduces the child, but no child appears in scene 1 (it appears only in scene 2 while the narration has moved on to the model).

Scene 2 (Two ordinary observations), sentences 1-2, all themes: the arrow to Explanation starts in the gap between the App choice and Feed cards, so it terminates on neither observation; the 'One possible link' and 'Question / Still uncertain' cards float unconnected instead of sitting beside the joining strip per the cue. Seven outlined cards plus a figure exceed the 2-6 salient-object guideline and read as a cluttered slide.

Scene 3 (A connection still to prove), all frames and themes: a free-floating arrow under the Comparison page connects to nothing, and nothing marks it as questioned; it reads as a stray directional claim.

Scene 4 (Before the story closes), both sentences, all themes: the arrow from Open book ends in the gap between the Original conversation and Later explanation cards; the cue 'reader's finger between them' is not implemented (the reader's hand stays beside the Open book card).

Scenes 2 and 4, all themes: the child and reader figures carry an unexplained thin dark bracket line across the torso (an unreadable prop fragment); the child's feet rest on the 'Shared room' label card. In Dark both figures become the same pale-blue identity, losing the Color/Light distinction between child and reader.

All scenes, all themes: objects are outlined label cards with empty lower halves (Conversation, Tablet, Open book, Original conversation, Later explanation), i.e. nested panel/frame clutter contrary to the flat, uncluttered rule; 'Tablet' and 'Open book' are labelled rectangles rather than recognisable objects.

Phone 320 and 393 px (Dark, scene 1): card sub-labels render at roughly 5-6 px and are unreadable; at 320 px the '01 / 04' chapter marker wraps onto two lines; at 393 px the paused play overlay covers the 'App choice' label.

defects.fix: Bring the hand to chin/jaw height in front of the face (or a palm-up doubt at chest height), use a sceptical face with one raised brow and flat or downturned mouth, and look at the questioned arc rather than at the viewer.

defects.what: The 'curious' expression renders as a downturned, unhappy mouth with worried brows, so at 0:17 the parent looks displeased while 'a model finds a way to connect the two' should read as interested and engaged. She also sits facing the viewer, hands resting, separated from the bridge she is meant to gesture toward; the explain gesture is not visible at the midpoint.
defects.fix: Use an interested expression (raised brows, neutral or slight smile), turn her body and gaze toward the laptop/bridge, and hold the explain gesture through the sentence midpoint. Optionally place the devices and bridge closer to the laptop so the model's answer visibly produces the bridge.

defects.what: The same 'curious' face reads as a frown/sad at 0:02 for the opening hook 'proposes a name for the pull to connect things', so the opening emotion reads as worried rather than curious.
defects.fix: Use raised brows with a neutral or open mouth for curious; avoid the downturned mouth.

defects.what: For 'It also puts its own proposed explanation under the same scrutiny' the reader stays at the far left, smiling and pointing at the tablet/arc, while the book with the magnifier sits at the far right edge. The reader is not engaging with the book, so the self-scrutiny beat is not performed by the character.
defects.fix: Turn the reader's gaze and pointing arm clearly toward the book (or move the book next to the reader, or move the reader between arc and book) and hold the gesture through the midpoint; a calm, attentive face rather than a broad smile.

defects.what: At the 0:09 midpoint the parent's arms hang at her sides (the planned open hand toward the child is not visible) and the child stands front-facing with a plain smile; the recoil/turn-to-videos beat is not legible in the frame. defects.fix: Hold the parent's invite gesture through the midpoint, turn the child's head/gaze toward the phone while smiling, and remove or recolour the white chest bar.

defects.what: The planned settling (arms lowering) does not happen: the reader's pose at 0:58 is identical to sentence 1 apart from the face and the question mark, so the closing question has little bodily change.
defects.fix: Lower both arms and the two pages slightly and tilt the head toward the open book for the reflective close.

defects.what: In Light the open book's white pages sit on the white stage with only thin lines, so the book reads weakly.
defects.fix: Give the pages a warm off-white/cream fill in the paper theme.
